arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="plcodex-passive-observer-") as directory:
    root = Path(directory) / "VPS"
    cmd = ["git", "clone", "--quiet", "--depth", "1", "--branch", "main",
           "https://github.com/martaxi-boss/VPS.git", str(root)]
    completed = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                               timeout=45, check=False)
    if completed.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError("Public Supervisor source checkout unavailable")
    sha = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(root), "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
                         capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=10).stdout.strip()
    sys.path.insert(0, str(root))
    from ops import supervisor_cloud_source as cloud
    from ops import supervisor_audit as audit
    def read_public(which: str, path: str):
        if which == "vps":
            if path != "actions/workflows/cloud-supervisor-observation.yml/runs?status=success&per_page=50":
                raise RuntimeError("Untrusted VPS API path")
            repo = "martaxi-boss/VPS"
        elif which == "project":
            if path != cloud.PULLS_PATH and not cloud.CHECKS_PATH.fullmatch(path):
                raise RuntimeError("Untrusted Cloud API path")
            repo = cloud.CLOUD_REPOSITORY
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("Invalid repository")
        url = "https://api.github.com/repos/" + repo + "/" + path
        request = Request(url, headers={
            "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
            "User-Agent": "Existing-Project-Leader-Passive-Supervisor",
            "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28",
        }, method="GET")
        try:
            with urlopen(request, timeout=22) as response:
                data = response.read(500001)
            if len(data) > 500000:
                raise RuntimeError("GitHub public payload too large")
            return json.loads(data.decode("utf-8"))
        except (HTTPError, URLError, TimeoutError, ValueError):
            raise RuntimeError("GitHub public observation failed") from None
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    since = cloud.last_observed_start(lambda method, path: read_public("vps", path)
                                      if method == "GET" else None, now)
    notices = cloud.messages(lambda path: read_public("project", path), since, now, limit=5)
    audited = [audit.observation(message, source="cloud") for message in notices]
    print("SUPERVISOR_EXECUTION_HOST=VPS")
    print("SUPERVISOR_SOURCE_SHA=" + sha)
    print("SUPERVISOR_NOTICES=" + str(len(audited)))
    for message in audited:
        print("SUPERVISOR_AUDITED_JSON=" + json.dumps(message, ensure_ascii=True))
    print("SUPERVISOR_PUBLIC_AUDIT=PASS")

PY
